Read this first **You are very welcome to make videos, streams and shorts with this mod.** All I ask, and it takes 10 secs : > **Credit the mod in your description or pinned comment**, with a link to this page and to **[meccha.dryaides.com](https://meccha.dryaides.com/)**. That is the whole deal. If you do, come say hi on [Discord](https://discord.gg/NxEFTr4Fv3), I will happily share your video. --- # 🦎 A hide-and-seek where you WANT to be seen Paint your white body to match the room, strike a pose, and freeze. You score by blending in *so well* that seekers stare right past you. It's **Meccha Chameleon**, brought into Minecraft. **SMP-friendly:** the chameleon gear is craftable in survival, so it drops straight onto your server. Grab some friends and see who has the sharpest eye! ## 🎥 Featured by Slogo (11.7M subscribers)! [![Watch Slogo play Meccha Crafteleon](https://img.youtube.com/vi/uoBKZZFl-mo/maxresdefault.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uoBKZZFl-mo) ## Controls `/meccha` opens the menu. **R** pose wheel · **F** paint · **G** whistle · **Esc** leave · **Sneak + Space** to climb walls ## Gallery
> **Fully playable end to end.** Paint, pose, rooms and hide-and-seek all work today, with new features and polish each version. *A fan tribute to Meccha Chameleon by **lemorion_1224**, not affiliated. [Go play the original!](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4704690/MECCHA_CHAMELEON/) Shotgun model & texture by **ECYsh364** (GWR3D resource pack).* *** Questions, ideas, or want to partner up? **[Join the Discord](https://discord.gg/NxEFTr4Fv3)** · support via **[ko-fi.com/aminoquiz](https://ko-fi.com/aminoquiz)**.
